choice.title: sq-aghft: perf(engine): avoid one-time O(numeric) scan on first numeric FILTER for graphs with a high-precision decimal (sq-lr2ii follow-up)

decision: GO_FOR_ONE_BOUNDED_WORK_COUNT_WITNESS; no implementation or measured benefit claim
why_this_frontier: Unlike one avoidable64row hash build, the current numeric safety memo can redo a dictionary-wide scan after every nonempty delete-only delta, although dictionary contents have not changed. Work scales with dictionary cardinality and mutation/query cycles. This is a concrete default-path source opportunity with no extra retained data structure. Relative latency or end-to-end importance remains unmeasured.

source_facts.fact: Cold high_precision_decimal state0 visits dictionary IDs1..=len and probes numeric cache, stopping only on an offending decimal. State1 returns false by atomic load.
Nonempty public delete request reaches apply_delta_mem; only both-empty public batches early-return. remove_triple delegates a nonempty delete slice.

Deletion resolves IDs without interning. Despite unchanged dict length for delete-only updates, memo1 is unconditionally reset to0. Next check scans again. This remains safe but needlessly discards evidence.
Numeric FILTER sargability consults Graph::has_high_precision_decimal before selecting fast numeric comparison; this is a real public-query planning seam.

narrow_scope: First establish repeated invalidation on a warmed numeric-safe Graph under delete-only nonempty deltas. If confirmed, consider preserving memo when dictionary length is unchanged; do not redesign initial cold scan, numeric semantics, ingest caches, fork/clone storage, or planner in this slice. The initial first-query scan remains outside that smallest fix.
safety_invariants: Never skip invalidation when new dictionary terms may introduce a high-precision decimal.
Keep state2 sticky; deleted triples do not remove terms from dictionary.
Preserve all current numeric literal classifications and exact FILTER fallback.
Do not infer empty apply_delta([],[]) invalidates: public method early-returns. Use a real nonempty deletion/control.

witness_plan.fixture: Finite generated integer-safe graph with a small queried predicate and many unrelated distinct terms. Record exact dictionary size. Warm safety memo; query/control; remove one unrelated existing triple; query/control again. Include a known-terms absent-triple deletion separately.
witness_plan.deterministic_assertions: Count cold-branch dictionary ID visits in actual Graph source via cfg(test) observer. Baseline cold call visits D IDs; immediate second call zero; nonempty delete-only causes another D despite identical dict length. Query result bag on untouched predicate unchanged. Observe actual engine sargability call if a bounded linked-engine harness is available; otherwise core seam proof and static caller evidence are explicitly separate.
witness_plan.positive_safety_controls: Fresh insertion of a new inexact decimal must change false→true; exact decimal, integer, known-term reinsertion, empty delta, and state2 cases preserve existing classification. Existing has_high_precision_decimal_memo_survives_delta_insert remains mandatory.
witness_plan.candidate_stage_control: Only after a fix exists: restore unconditional1→0 reset and require actual visit-count assertion to fail; bypass new-term invalidation must fail decimal safety test. No wall-clock unit assertion.
witness_plan.measurement_needed: Later fixed cold/warm/delete-query versus exact main whole-query latency/allocation comparison; preserve ingestion/update costs and no universal speedup claim.
